name: Bar-jesus
bio: Bar-jesus, a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet also known as Elymas, attended the Roman proconsul Sergius Paulus on Cyprus and tried to turn him away from the faith as he listened to Barnabas and Saul. Saul, filled with the Holy Spirit, denounced him as a child of the devil and an enemy of righteousness and declared that the Lord would strike him blind; a mist and darkness immediately fell on him, and he had to be led by the hand (Acts 13:6-11).
